note: Articles from three OpenEdition journals: Revue francaise des sciences de l'information et de la communication, Questions de communication, and Terrain. Academic French set properly by the platform, which is what qualifies it: guillemets carry a real no-break space and apostrophes are U+2019, so a finding here is a suspected false positive rather than a recall test. Three journals so that one copy editor's habits do not stand in for published French.
